caption: A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Green roller on metal fence; paint saturated, motion implied, uniformity achieved. Unknown: roller path, paint re-dip timing, exact coverage rate.

INTERACTION: Roller’s saturated state → consistent overlap → even coat; re-dip → sustained saturation → continuous coverage.

PERSISTENCE: Paint viscosity and roller texture sustain uniform transfer; fence surface resistance propagates evenness; motion continuity maintains streak-free result.

INTERVENTION: If saturation drops → coverage gaps; if motion inconsistent → streaks; if re-dip absent → unevenness; fence texture unchanged → persistence of uniformity remains.
